name: Kamiichi (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Kamiichi town emblem in yellow: an outlined ring enclosing a stylised mountain, with the character 市 below.
history: Municipal flag of Kamiichi, a town in Toyama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 28 March 1954.

features.role: Kamiichi town emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a stylised mountain, with the character 市 below
